findings: Severskaya (2024, pp. 334–348; relevant analysis pp. 334–337) reports the normative imperative поезжай, colloquial езжай, and non-normative просторечное ехай, with National Corpus counts. This conflicts with the article’s description of езжай as neutral standard. Gramota’s current reference answer № 327225 (2025-12-18) also recommends only поезжай; the Gramota journal article distinguishes colloquial езжай from normative поезжай.

The article additionally groups singular езжай and plural езжайте under the target verb ехать. The Gramota dictionary portal labels езжай conversational for поезжай and separately lists езжайте as an imperative under езжать/ездить; the exact standard status and paradigm relation must be resolved before editing.
limitations: Do not mark VERIFIED. Resolve status of поезжай, езжай, ехай, едь, and езжайте using the full article, current dictionary editions, and the full cited corpus study. Then revise the article to limit claims and create/validate canonical Evidence with claim-level locators.

sources.scope: The paper distinguishes normative поезжай from conversational езжай and non-normative ехай and presents corpus counts.

sources.scope: Answer gives поезжай as the correct normative form; does not discuss every inflected variant.
